prompt: What firmware should a mining farm with 10,000 Antminer S19 and S21 units use to reduce power consumption?
answer_text:
To optimize power consumption across your mining farm of 10,000 Antminer S19 and S21 units, implementing specialized firmware can significantly enhance efficiency. Here are some recommended firmware options:


[Antminer S9, S9i, S9j firmware](https://www.awesomeminer.com/firmware/antminer-s9?utm_source=openai)
**Awesome Miner Antminer Firmware**  
This firmware offers improved hashrate performance and power efficiency for Antminer S19 and S21 models. It provides easy-to-use presets for overclocking and underclocking, allowing you to adjust performance and power usage to your preference. Additionally, it supports features like sleep mode to pause mining and consume minimal power, and immersion cooling support. ([awesomeminer.com](https://www.awesomeminer.com/firmware/antminer-s21?utm_source=openai))



[Antminer S19+ Hash Board Repair Guide | Zeus Mining](https://www.zeusbtc.com/articles/information/3529-antminer-s19-plus-hash-board-repair-guide?utm_source=openai)
**AnMiner Firmware**  
AnMiner's firmware is designed to increase hashrate by up to 50% and reduce power consumption by up to 20%. It offers advanced overclocking capabilities, rich functionality, and is user-friendly. The firmware supports various Antminer models, including S19 and S21 series. ([anminer.com](https://anminer.com/firmware/bitmain/?utm_source=openai))



[Antminer S19 95TH/s ASIC | Boosted to 105TH/s | VNiSH™ OS | Refurbished | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/itm/286476289055?utm_source=openai)
**VNISH Firmware**  
VNISH provides professional custom firmware for Antminer S19 and S21 units, featuring per-chip autotuning, ASICBoost, immersion mode, and fleet management. It allows for per-chip autotuning, adjusting voltage and frequency individually for optimal performance and stability. The firmware also includes a Low Power Mode (LPM) for setting lower power targets with frequency and voltage controls. ([vnish-software.com](https://vnish-software.com/?utm_source=openai))



[S19J Pro+ 120TH abnormal in Low Power Mode](https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=5458447.0&utm_source=openai)
**Braiins OS+**  
Braiins OS+ is an open-source firmware that offers advanced features like auto-tuning, which automatically adjusts frequency and voltage for each chip to maximize efficiency. It provides modes such as Efficiency Mode, which reduces power consumption by 10-25% while maintaining or increasing hashrate, and Performance Mode, which pushes hashrate above stock levels while keeping efficiency within acceptable bounds. ([d-central.tech](https://d-central.tech/antminer-s19-power-efficiency-tips-for-cost-effective-bitcoin-mining/?utm_source=openai))


Implementing any of these firmware solutions can help you achieve significant power savings across your mining farm. It's advisable to test each firmware on a subset of your miners to determine which offers the best balance between performance and power efficiency for your specific setup.
